implementation_examples.text: Automatically create and assign tickets in the organization's ticketing system when certain types of alerts occur

implementation_examples.title: Ex4
implementation_examples.text: Manually create and assign tickets in the organization's ticketing system when technical staff discover indicators of compromise

subcategories.text: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Securely provide cyber threat intelligence feeds to detection technologies, processes, and personnel

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Securely provide information from asset inventories to detection technologies, processes, and personnel

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Rapidly acquire and analyze vulnerability disclosures for the organization's technologies from suppliers, vendors, and third-party security advisories

subcategories.text: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Apply incident criteria to known and assumed characteristics of activity in order to determine whether an incident should be declared

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Take known false positives into account when applying incident criteria

subcategories.category_text: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed
subcategories.text: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Detection technologies automatically report confirmed incidents

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Request incident response assistance from the organization's incident response outsourcer

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Designate an incident lead for each incident

implementation_examples.title: Ex4
implementation_examples.text: Initiate execution of additional cybersecurity plans as needed to support incident response (for example, business continuity and disaster recovery)

subcategories.category_text: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed
subcategories.text: Incident reports are triaged and validated

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Preliminarily review incident reports to confirm that they are cybersecurity-related and necessitate incident response activities

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Apply criteria to estimate the severity of an incident

subcategories.category_text: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed
subcategories.text: Incidents are categorized and prioritized

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Further review and categorize incidents based on the type of incident (e.g., data breach, ransomware, DDoS, account compromise)

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Prioritize incidents based on their scope, likely impact, and time-critical nature

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Select incident response strategies for active incidents by balancing the need to quickly recover from an incident with the need to observe the attacker or conduct a more thorough investigation

subcategories.category_text: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed
subcategories.text: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Track and validate the status of all ongoing incidents

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Coordinate incident escalation or elevation with designated internal and external stakeholders

subcategories.category_text: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed
subcategories.text: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Apply incident recovery criteria to known and assumed characteristics of the incident to determine whether incident recovery processes should be initiated

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Take the possible operational disruption of incident recovery activities into account

subcategories.category_text: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities
subcategories.text: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Determine the sequence of events that occurred during the incident and which assets and resources were involved in each event

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Attempt to determine what vulnerabilities, threats, and threat actors were directly or indirectly involved in the incident

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Analyze the incident to find the underlying, systemic root causes

implementation_examples.title: Ex4
implementation_examples.text: Check any cyber deception technology for additional information on attacker behavior

subcategories.category_text: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities
subcategories.text: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Require each incident responder and others (e.g., system administrators, cybersecurity engineers) who perform incident response tasks to record their actions and make the record immutable

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Require the incident lead to document the incident in detail and be responsible for preserving the integrity of the documentation and the sources of all information being reported

subcategories.category_text: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities
subcategories.text: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Collect, preserve, and safeguard the integrity of all pertinent incident data and metadata (e.g., data source, date/time of collection) based on evidence preservation and chain-of-custody procedures

subcategories.category_text: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities
subcategories.text: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Review other potential targets of the incident to search for indicators of compromise and evidence of persistence

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Automatically run tools on targets to look for indicators of compromise and evidence of persistence

subcategories.category_text: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies
subcategories.text: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Follow the organization's breach notification procedures after discovering a data breach incident, including notifying affected customers

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Notify business partners and customers of incidents in accordance with contractual requirements

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Notify law enforcement agencies and regulatory bodies of incidents based on criteria in the incident response plan and management approval

subcategories.category_text: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies
subcategories.text: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Securely share information consistent with response plans and information sharing agreements

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Voluntarily share information about an attacker's observed TTPs, with all sensitive data removed, with an Information Sharing and Analysis Center (ISAC)

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Notify HR when malicious insider activity occurs

implementation_examples.title: Ex4
implementation_examples.text: Regularly update senior leadership on the status of major incidents

implementation_examples.title: Ex5
implementation_examples.text: Follow the rules and protocols defined in contracts for incident information sharing between the organization and its suppliers

implementation_examples.title: Ex6
implementation_examples.text: Coordinate crisis communication methods between the organization and its critical suppliers

subcategories.category_text: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects
subcategories.text: Incidents are contained

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Cybersecurity technologies (e.g., antivirus software) and cybersecurity features of other technologies (e.g., operating systems, network infrastructure devices) automatically perform containment actions

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Allow incident responders to manually select and perform containment actions

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Allow a third party (e.g., internet service provider, managed security service provider) to perform containment actions on behalf of the organization

implementation_examples.title: Ex4
implementation_examples.text: Automatically transfer compromised endpoints to a remediation virtual local area network (VLAN)

subcategories.category_text: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects
subcategories.text: Incidents are eradicated

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Cybersecurity technologies and cybersecurity features of other technologies (e.g., operating systems, network infrastructure devices) automatically perform eradication actions

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Allow incident responders to manually select and perform eradication actions

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Allow a third party (e.g., managed security service provider) to perform eradication actions on behalf of the organization

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents
subcategories.text: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Begin recovery procedures during or after incident response processes

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Make all individuals with recovery responsibilities aware of the plans for recovery and the authorizations required to implement each aspect of the plans

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents
subcategories.text: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Select recovery actions based on the criteria defined in the incident response plan and available resources

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Change planned recovery actions based on a reassessment of organizational needs and resources

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents
subcategories.text: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Check restoration assets for indicators of compromise, file corruption, and other integrity issues before use

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents
subcategories.text: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Use business impact and system categorization records (including service delivery objectives) to validate that essential services are restored in the appropriate order

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Work with system owners to confirm the successful restoration of systems and the return to normal operations

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Monitor the performance of restored systems to verify the adequacy of the restoration

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents
subcategories.text: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Check restored assets for indicators of compromise and remediation of root causes of the incident before production use

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Verify the correctness and adequacy of the restoration actions taken before putting a restored system online

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents
subcategories.text: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Prepare an after-action report that documents the incident itself, the response and recovery actions taken, and lessons learned

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Declare the end of incident recovery once the criteria are met

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties
subcategories.text: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Securely share recovery information, including restoration progress, consistent with response plans and information sharing agreements

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Regularly update senior leadership on recovery status and restoration progress for major incidents

implementation_examples.title: Ex3
implementation_examples.text: Follow the rules and protocols defined in contracts for incident information sharing between the organization and its suppliers

implementation_examples.title: Ex4
implementation_examples.text: Coordinate crisis communication between the organization and its critical suppliers

subcategories.category_text: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties
subcategories.text: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging

implementation_examples.title: Ex1
implementation_examples.text: Follow the organization's breach notification procedures for recovering from a data breach incident

implementation_examples.title: Ex2
implementation_examples.text: Explain the steps being taken to recover from the incident and to prevent a recurrence
